description: This is the main HTML source of a web-based database viewer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic behaviors such as fetching database and table data, rendering tables, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the backend API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data rows from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts the HTML table based on data fetched from the backend.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates an individual table cell, handling nulls, objects, and long text values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or object data to show full content.

search-terms: API fetch calls for database schema
